examples.label: Price filter in a shop sidebar
examples.source: <.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="medium" font_weight="font-semibold">Filter by price <.component component_name="chelekom-small" site="Global" class="block mt-1 mb-5 text-gray-500">Showing items up to $450 <.component component_name="chelekom-range-field" site="Global" id="shop-price-filter" name="max_price" value="450" min="0" max="1000" step="10" label="Maximum price"> <:range_value position="start" class="text-gray-500">$0 <:range_value position="middle" class="text-gray-500">$500 <:range_value position="end" class="text-gray-500">$1,000

examples.label: Budget slider in a quote request form
examples.source:
<.component component_name="chelekom-form-wrapper" site="Global" for={%{}} id="quote-budget-form" class="max-w-lg rounded-xl border border-gray-200 dark:border-gray-700 p-6">
  <.component component_name="chelekom-h4" site="Global" size="large" font_weight="font-semibold">What is your budget for this project?</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-small" site="Global" class="block mt-1 mb-6 text-gray-500">Drag the slider — we will send a proposal that fits the range.</.component>
  <.component component_name="chelekom-range-field" site="Global" id="quote-budget" name="budget" value="25000" min="5000" max="100000" step="1000" label="Project budget in USD" color="success">
    <:range_value position="start" class="text-gray-500">$5k</:range_value>
    <:range_value position="end" class="text-gray-500">$100k</:range_value>
  </.component>
  <:actions>
    <.component component_name="chelekom-button" site="Global" type="submit" variant="default" color="primary">Request a quote</.component>
  </:actions>
</.component>
